content.short: Bankr is a conversational onchain agent for trading, launching tokens and treasury automation.
content.description: Bankr is an AI agent that buys, sells and swaps tokens and places limit orders from a chat instruction. Every agent built on it receives a cross-chain wallet that can trade, deploy contracts and manage DeFi positions, with gas covered by the platform. Developers install the CLI, run a login that generates a wallet and API key, and can launch a token for free. Trading fees the agent generates pay for its own compute, so there is no recurring hosting bill.
content.meta: Execute trades, token launches and treasury tasks onchain by describing them in plain language.
